title: Cozy
text: Cozy. This is a fluffy and nice simple topper for the bed. Soft and warm, but not smothering. It did have a very strong chemical smell when I took it out of the packaging. Good purchase so far.

product_metadata.title: DWR Full/Queen Alternative Down Comforter - Super Soft Fit 3D-air Cloud Fluffy Eucalyptus Microfiber Comforter Set with Shams, Medium Weight All Season Duvet, White
features: ✅【Premium Material For Soft And Fluffy】 Made of Brushed microfiber fabric and filled with eucalyptus down alternative fiberfill, our comforter is super soft, fluffy, lightweight, quiet, no smell - ensures a peaceful sleeping experience as if you were sleeping in a cloud. This QUEEN size white comforter set includes 1 Comforter (88”x88”) and 2 Queen Shams (20”x30”).

✅【Trendy Design With Multiple Use】 Popular colors reversible comforter set, with multiple colors (White, Grey/Red, Navy/Blue, Yellow/Gray, Red/Beige etc.) and 3 sizes (Twin, Full/Queen, King) to meet different needs. You can use it as a duvet insert, stand-alone comforter, or quilt.
✅【Breathable & Comfortable】 This bed comforter set fillings are made of mixed Eucalyptus Lyocell fiberfill, 280gsm fill weight. It’s also sustainable approved by GRS and OEKO-TEX standard 100.

✅【Exquisite Craftsmanship】 Well-distributed wavy-stitched technology helps set the whole filling in place, with ZERO concern about shifting or clumping even after wash. Corner tabs to secure a duvet cover easily. Strong hems, durable and long-lasting.

✅【Your Satisfaction】This eucalyptus comforter is Machine washable and dryable. If you are not satisfied with the product you received, please do not hesitate to contact us so that we can solve the problems for you. We just want you to be satisfied with our product and service. Advice: Come with vacuum package, please air and spread it at first-time use.
